review:
The horse collect game on 6x7 Megaways, with up to 117,649 ways, tumbles and money symbols up to 15x. Four fixed jackpots range from 20x to 2,500x.

The bonus triggers when scatter and collect symbols land together. Before it starts, you can gamble up to five times for more spins, and the odds improve after each success. Sticky collectors trigger respins in the bonus. Up to 5,000x, 96.46% RTP. That gamble changes the risk a lot.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
